properties.name: Spot Pitch
properties.description: Distance between spot centres in pixels. 0 auto-detects from the image dimensions (Evolve3 552x413 uses 17.0, Evolve2 697x520 uses 21.5).

properties.name: Spot Size
properties.description: Fraction of the spot pitch a spot occupies. Drawn spot diameter is Spot Pitch multiplied by Spot Size.

properties.name: Default Cycle
properties.description: Which image to select when a grid is opened: 'highest' for the highest-numbered cycle, 'grid' for the grid image itself, or an explicit cycle number such as 94.
